Split trajectory by time gap

Source: R/divide.track.by.gap.R
divide.track.by.gap.Rd

Splits individual tracking trajectories into multiple segments if the time difference between consecutive locations exceeds a specified threshold.

Usage

divide.track.by.gap(data, ids, time.col, gap.days)

Arguments

data

A data.frame containing the tracking data.

ids

Character. The name of the column containing individual identifiers.

time.col

Character. The name of the column containing timestamps (must be POSIXct or Date).

gap.days

Numeric or named list. The maximum allowed gap in days before splitting the track. Can be a single numeric value for all individuals, or a named list specifying different thresholds per individual.

Value

A data.frame identical to the input but with an additional column id_split representing the new segmented identifiers.

Examples

# Split tracks wherever two consecutive fixes are more than 3 hours apart
split_trk <- divide.track.by.gap(sim_tracks, ids = "ID",
                                 time.col = "timestamp", gap.days = 3 / 24)
table(split_trk$id_split)
#> 
#> F02_1 F02_2 F02_3 F02_4 F04_1 F04_2 F04_3 F04_4 F04_5 F04_6 F04_7 F05_1 F05_2 
#>   173    25    26   514     9   361    93    80    35   164     4    75   203 
#> F05_3 F05_4 F05_5 M01_1 M01_2 M01_3 M01_4 M01_5 M01_6 M01_7 M03_1 M03_2 M03_3 
#>     4     7   121   116   172   145   285    19   310     8    65   119    39 
#> M03_4 
#>   218
